comparison.objective: Serve a drink through a self-closing drive-thru window.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring-loaded slider while transporting and placing a cup, then withdraw before closure.
comparison.success_condition: The cup is upright on the outer shelf, both arms are inside, and the window closes without contact or cup damage.
comparison.reason: Although bimanual load coordination appears in both, this record tests constrained handoff through a closing barrier, not selective many-body sieving or screen reseating.
